text: Athena never deletes a job's build cache. Each job's state directory keeps its own Rust target directory (11 to 12 GB each), and on 2026-10-23 two of them, one from an interrupted job of 2026-10-17, filled the session's disk allowance mid-run, so job 20261019-013306-zvmr died committing its candidate. Delete a job's target directory once the job closes (landed, failed, rejected, abandoned or interrupted and then closed), and report the space reclaimed; consider sharing one target directory across jobs if the checks allow it.
